notes.title: Project Mayhem Early Access Release Date – July 15th
notes.notes: [p]Mayhem-makers, assemble! On July 15th, Project Mayhem storms into Early Access, bringing all the unpredictable, grenade-blasting fun you crave. Wishlist today and be among the first to dive into the wildest PvP party of the summer. Let’s blow stuff up—together![/p]
